❯ Run exactly this one bash command with the Bash tool and nothing else, do not
  shorten it: echo made-up-alpha made-up-beta made-up-gamma made-up-delta
  made-up-epsilon made-up-zeta made-up-eta made-up-theta made-up-iota
  made-up-kappa made-up-lambda made-up-mu > made-up-out.txt && cat
  made-up-out.txt | tr a-z A-Z | sort | uniq -c | head -n 3

● Writing test words to a file, then uppercase and counting lines
  ⎿  $ echo made-up-alpha made-up-beta made-up-gamma made-up-delta
     made-up-epsilon made-up-zeta made-up-eta made-up-theta made-up-iota
     made-up-kappa made-up-lambda made-up-mu > made-up-out.txt && cat
     made-up-out.txt | tr a-z A-Z | sort | uniq -c | head -n 3
